contexts.text: Serpents and scorpions () = evils and the falsities of evil: to tread upon them = to destroy them.
Tails like scorpions, and stings in their tails () = adroit reasonings from falsities through which they persuade, and thus injure...
By a scorpion () is signified their Persuasive... Their tails like scorpions = persuasions.

Power was given (the locusts), as the scorpions of the earth have Power () = the power of persuading that their falsities are truths. By a scorpion is signified a deadly Persuasive; and by a scorpion of the earth, a Persuasive in the Things of the Church... For a scorpion, when it strikes a man, induces a stupor on his members; and, if it is not healed, a death. The like is induced on the understanding by their Persuasive. Illustrated.

Their torment was as the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a man () = that this (stupor) is from their Persuasive... A scorpion = this Persuasive. In the Spiritual World there is a Persuasive which takes away the understanding of truth, and induces a stupor and thus a pain on the lower mind; but this Persuasive is unknown in the natural world.
They had tails like scorpions () = the falsified truths of the Word by which they induce a stupor... a scorpion = a Persuasive which induces a stupor on the understanding.
Like one who... sees a scorpion and believes it to be a bird...
They are like... scorpions, which when triturated and mixed with oil, at once snatch to themselves all the poison of a wound.
Their fingers were... as it were the digits of a scorpion.
As bruised scorpions... imbibe poison, and thus protect others from dying from the bites of other scorpions.
A scorpion = what is persuasive infatuating and suffocating. Explained. AE 549. AE 559.
Deadly persuasions are signified by scorpions, in the following passages.

Serpents and scorpions () = the crew of Satan, which had been in cunning, and in a direful Persuasive of falsity, by which men after death are spiritually murdered, unless they are protected by the Lord. The antediluvians... were pre-eminently in such a Persuasive... That the Lord delivered the Spiritual World from these and the like, is meant by His seeing Satan fall from Heaven, and by His giving those who are in truths from good from Him, the Power to tread opon serpents and scorpions.
Scorpions = a direful Persuasive, also in ... To dwell among scorpions = among those who have persuaded themselves and strongly persuade others of falsities, and do not admit any truth...

As the temptations of the faithful are effected through injections and persuasions of falsities by evil Spirits, it is said that they were led through a formidable desert of the serpent, the fire-serpent, and the scorpion (). (The scorpions, here, = persuasions. AE 730-34.)
